claims.statement: The Foo Valley Municipal Utility confirmed that on 14 July 2025 the Lower Basin treatment works dosed chlorine at four times the permitted level for roughly three hours.

sources.title: Incident report: treatment works, July 2025
sources.supporting_excerpt: On 14 July 2025 the Lower Basin treatment works dosed chlorine at four times the permitted level for roughly three hours, the utility confirmed.

claims.statement: The Regional Health Office recorded 48 cases of skin irritation at Riverside Clinic between 14 and 17 July 2025.

sources.title: Skin irritation cluster, Eastfield
sources.supporting_excerpt: The Regional Health Office recorded 48 cases of skin irritation at Riverside Clinic between 14 and 17 July 2025.

claims.notes: The office does not link the cluster to the dosing incident.

claims.statement: An anonymous forum user wrote that trucks dump drums into the river every Friday night near Millbrook.

sources.title: Night dumping?
sources.supporting_excerpt: A user who did not give a name wrote that trucks dump drums into the river every Friday night near Millbrook.
